scope: 48 independent font/weight/half-point cases; actual paint and metadata-only native page/PDF paths remain distinct. Font programs remain opaque. No renderer correction is established.

conclusion: All 48 observed native font sizes round to a 0.12pt grid on both native paths. Applying those sizes to isolated browser measurements worsens many origins. The native emission size does not establish a layout measurement rule or prove glyph-ink equivalence.
